- Windows: video no longer hangs with the Fast quality setting.
- Errors during video processing now show in the app instead of leaving it waiting.
- Follow motion shows whether optical flow runs on the GPU or the CPU.

CUDA builds need CUDA 13 and cuDNN 9. On Linux, use the `.deb` for GPU. What's new in 4.0: [v4.0.0](https://github.com/altunenes/scramblery/releases/tag/v4.0.0).
